name: knitting-bean-cosy-gpt-6-luna-s3-r3
caseTitle: Knitting chart: coffee bean cup cosy
prompt: Make an SVG knitting chart for a cup cosy with a coffee-bean motif, drawn so the beans come out the right shape in the finished fabric.

grade.detail: bean knits 1.16 long to 1 wide at gauge 1.33

source.text:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1000" height="1120" viewBox="0 0 1000 1120">
  <defs>
    <pattern id="stitchGrid" width="24" height="18" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
      <path d="M24 0H0V18" fill="none" stroke="#cbbda8" stroke-width="0.8"/>
    </pattern>
    <g id="bean" shape-rendering="crispEdges">
      <!-- One chart square = one stitch: 10 stitches wide by 12 rounds tall. -->
      <path fill="#67402e" d="M4 0H6V1H8V2H9V4H10V8H9V10H8V11H6V12H4V11H2V10H1V8H0V4H1V2H2V1H4Z"/>
      <!-- Sweeping one-stitch channel is charted diagonally to read as a bean crease in stockinette. -->
      <path d="M4 0H3V2H4V4H5V6H6V8H7V10H6V12" fill="none" stroke="#f4eee3" stroke-width="0.72" stroke-linejoin="miter"/>
    </g>
  </defs>
  <rect width="1000" height="1120" fill="#f4eee3"/>
  <text x="72" y="58" fill="#a36b3f" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700" letter-spacing="3">STITCH & STEAM  /  CUP COZY SERIES</text>
  <text x="72" y="116" fill="#30251e" font-family="Georgia,serif" font-size="48" font-weight="700">Coffee bean</text>
  <text x="74" y="151" fill="#755f4f" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="16" letter-spacing="1.2">A two-colour stranded chart for a snug, reusable cup cosy</text>
  <text x="928" y="91" text-anchor="end" fill="#67402e" font-family="Georgia,serif" font-size="18" font-style="italic">No. 04</text>
  <text x="928" y="119" text-anchor="end" fill="#8a7968" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" letter-spacing="1.5">24 ST × 36 RND</text>
  <path d="M72 182H928" stroke="#cbbda8" stroke-width="1.2"/>

  <text x="212" y="224" fill="#67402e" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" letter-spacing="2">THE REPEAT</text>
  <text x="788" y="224" text-anchor="end" fill="#8a7968" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" letter-spacing="1">24 STITCHES  ×  36 ROUNDS</text>
  <text x="212" y="249" fill="#8a7968" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="11">Work in the round · chart is read from the right side</text>

  <!-- Chart field: 24 stitches wide by 36 rounds high. Each chart cell is wider than tall to account for stitch gauge. -->
  <rect x="212" y="280" width="576" height="648" fill="#f8f4ec" stroke="#8c7864" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <rect x="212" y="280" width="576" height="648" fill="url(#stitchGrid)"/>
  <!-- Four 10-stitch × 12-round beans in each 24-stitch × 36-round repeat. -->
  <use href="#bean" xlink:href="#bean" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" transform="translate(236 298) scale(24 18)"/>
  <use href="#bean" xlink:href="#bean" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" transform="translate(524 298) scale(24 18)"/>
  <use href="#bean" xlink:href="#bean" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" transform="translate(236 622) scale(24 18)"/>
  <use href="#bean" xlink:href="#bean" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" transform="translate(524 622) scale(24 18)"/>
  <!-- Keep individual stitch/round boundaries legible over the colourwork. -->
  <rect x="212" y="280" width="576" height="648" fill="url(#stitchGrid)"/>
  <!-- Stronger five-stitch / five-round guides -->
  <g stroke="#a9957e" stroke-width="1.1" opacity="0.78">
    <path d="M332 280V928 M452 280V928 M572 280V928 M692 280V928"/>
    <path d="M212 370H788 M212 460H788 M212 550H788 M212 640H788 M212 730H788 M212 820H788 M212 910H788"/>
  </g>
  <rect x="212" y="280" width="576" height="648" fill="none" stroke="#8c7864" stroke-width="1.2"/>

  <!-- Stitch and round coordinates -->
  <g fill="#8a7968" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">
    <text x="224" y="271">1</text><text x="320" y="271">5</text><text x="440" y="271">10</text><text x="560" y="271">15</text><text x="680" y="271">20</text><text x="776" y="271">24</text>
  </g>
  <g fill="#8a7968" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="9" text-anchor="end">
    <text x="203" y="292">1</text><text x="203" y="364">5</text><text x="203" y="454">10</text><text x="203" y="544">15</text><text x="203" y="634">20</text><text x="203" y="724">25</text><text x="203" y="814">30</text><text x="203" y="904">35</text>
  </g>
  <g fill="#8a7968" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="9" text-anchor="start">
    <text x="797" y="292">1</text><text x="797" y="364">5</text><text x="797" y="454">10</text><text x="797" y="544">15</text><text x="797" y="634">20</text><text x="797" y="724">25</text><text x="797" y="814">30</text><text x="797" y="904">35</text>
  </g>

  <path d="M72 964H928" stroke="#cbbda8" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <text x="72" y="994" fill="#67402e" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" letter-spacing="2">KEY</text>
  <rect x="72" y="1010" width="26" height="22" rx="2" fill="#f8f4ec" stroke="#cbbda8"/>
  <path d="M80.5 1010V1032 M89 1010V1032 M72 1017H98 M72 1025H98" stroke="#cbbda8" stroke-width="0.7"/>
  <text x="110" y="1020" fill="#30251e" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700">MC · Oat</text>
  <text x="110" y="1037" fill="#8a7968" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="11">Background stitch</text>
  <rect x="260" y="1010" width="26" height="22" rx="2" fill="#67402e"/>
  <path d="M273 1010V1032 M260 1017H286 M260 1025H286" stroke="#96765e" stroke-width="0.7"/>
  <text x="298" y="1020" fill="#30251e" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700">CC · Espresso</text>
  <text x="298" y="1037" fill="#8a7968" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="11">Bean stitches</text>
  <text x="928" y="1009" text-anchor="end" fill="#67402e" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" letter-spacing="1">KNIT IN THE ROUND</text>
  <text x="928" y="1032" text-anchor="end" fill="#755f4f" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12">Cast on a multiple of 24; repeat chart around.</text>
  <text x="928" y="1051" text-anchor="end" fill="#755f4f" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12">Read every round right to left. Carry floats loosely.</text>
  <path d="M72 1074H928" stroke="#cbbda8" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="72" y="1096" fill="#8a7968" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="10" letter-spacing="1">CHARTED FOR STOCKINETTE · GAUGE: 24 ST × 36 R = 10 CM (4 IN)</text>
  <text x="928" y="1096" text-anchor="end" fill="#8a7968" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="10" letter-spacing="1">STITCHES MAKE THE SHAPE</text>
</svg>
